content.comment_body: Is there a [product_name] version that can read signals from incremental encoders or handle high-speed counter (HSC) channels?

Hello, Yes, you can connect an encoder to a [product_name] if these conditions are met: you’re using the DC model of the device, you only need to read one channel, and pulse frequency doesn’t exceed 5kHz. Refer to the documentation in the [product_name]-related software for more details. Regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], [user_name]’s information is correct. In the device specifications, channels I3, I4, I5, and I6 can be used for fast counting, but note the main limitation: frequency should not exceed 5kHz.
How can I connect a 4-channel quadrature encoder to detect rotation direction and calculate RPM?
Yes, in the specifications, channels I3, I4, I5, and I6 are available for fast counting. Thanks and regards, [user_name]
Hello, These inputs can be used as high-speed counters for frequencies below 5kHz, but I don’t think it’s suitable as an encoder.

Hi, Using a quadrature encoder with dual channels for direction detection isn’t reliably supported on [product_name]. You could attempt some programming to detect direction changes, but it’s not guaranteed. As an alternative, let the drive send signals to indicate movement direction. There are external counters designed to interpret these signals and convert them for various counting applications. If advanced functions are needed, consider using a [version_no] device.
Please review [user_name]'s answer in the thread about motor control for further information. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discussed whether [product_name] devices can reliably read incremental or quadrature encoder signals, focusing on direction detection and RPM measurement. The core technical limitation is that only single-channel input is supported and the maximum read frequency is 5kHz. Multiple comments clarified that [product_name] cannot reliably detect direction or handle quadrature signals due to hardware/software restrictions. Suggestions included using external counters or switching to other [company_name] products like [version_no] for advanced counting requirements.
